evals.prompt: Run the benchmark for tasks t01 and t02 only and compare against the previous baseline of 50%
evals.expected_output: A structured eval report with task-by-task comparison and a COMMIT/REVERT/INVESTIGATE decision
expectations: Runs make task TASKS='t01 t02' rather than the full benchmark
Computes delta vs the provided baseline
Issues exactly one of: COMMIT, REVERT, NEUTRAL, INVESTIGATE
Decision follows the documented rules (not committed to COMMIT when delta is 0)
